briefdescription.para: Execute a void-returning callable within a temporary assumption scope.

detaileddescription.para: Overload for callables that return void. Pushes a new scope, applies declarations, invokes the callable, and pops the scope. Exception-safe: the scope is popped even if the callable throws.

parameterdescription.para: Callable type (must be invocable with no arguments, returning void)
Set of assumption declarations to apply in the new scope
Function to invoke under the temporary assumptions

briefdescription.para: Execute a callable within a temporary assumption scope.

detaileddescription.para: Pushes a new scope on the context, applies all declarations from the provided set, invokes the callable, pops the scope, and returns the result. Exception-safe: the scope is popped even if the callable throws.

parameterdescription.para: Callable type (must be invocable with no arguments)
Set of assumption declarations to apply in the new scope
Function to invoke under the temporary assumptions

briefdescription.para: Applies assumptions for the duration of a void callable.
Applies assumptions for the duration of a non-void callable.

detaileddescription.para: Returns CasError on declaration or callable failure. The scope is always removed before returning.

briefdescription.para: AssumptionContext class with scoped push/pop management.

detaileddescription.para: Provides a scope stack where each scope has its own PropertyStore and RelationStore. Queries read through from the top scope down to the root, with child scope declarations shadowing parent declarations.
